name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: domain=dialog, descriptor=drop_swap_text_id, _param suffix marks it as a staging parameter consumed by the recursive dialog call. No Ghidra address residue (suffix is _param, not a hex literal). Name accurately reflects both the data nature (a dialog text id value) and the purpose (drop/swap path, dialog VM opcode -5). Matches the established sibling naming (data_fd2_dialog_last_action_sprite_id_param @ 0x53AD9, data_fd2_dialog_last_action_value_param @ 0x53AE1).
purpose: Transient 32-bit staging slot holding the item-name dialog text id for the bag-full drop/swap sub-dialog, written by the tile-event interaction handler and consumed by the dialog VM on recursive opcode -5.
logic_summary: Single writer fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction @ 0x1937B: on a full-bag item pickup the player swaps out an existing item; the writer stores (swapped_out_item_id + 0xB5) (item-name text id = item_id + 0xB5) into this slot, then shows swap-confirmation dialog text 0x1A9. Single reader fd2_display_dialog_scene @ 0x1609D: dialog bytecode opcode -5 (0xFFFFFFFB) pushes this dword as the page/text id argument to a recursive fd2_display_dialog_scene call, rendering the swapped-out item's name inside the surrounding dialog. Always written before first read on the only path that reaches opcode -5 in that context.
datatype: uint32 (dialog text id / page index into data_fd2_all_game_text)
element_semantics: Scalar dword: item-name dialog text id (= swapped-out item id + 0xB5). Consumed as the page_idx argument to the recursive dialog VM call (opcode -5 path).
notes: Memory is zero (BSS, .object2), confirming runtime staging variable not a const table. Both access widths verified byte-exact: write MOV [0x00053add],EAX @ 0x1937B (preceded by MOV EAX,[ESP+0xc]; ADD EAX,0xb5); read PUSH dword ptr [0x00053add] @ 0x1609D under CMP EAX,-0x5 opcode dispatch. Existing src comment block (menufld.c lines 578-589) was already accurate, precise, and ASCII (kept unchanged). Ghidra data plate was null/empty; created one mirroring the src conclusion and matching the sibling plate at 0x53AE1 (which already cross-references this symbol). save_program succeeded.
